summary.headline: Talbros reported strong Q2 FY27 with revenue growth of about 19% YoY, with Mareli (JV) revenue growing 40-50% but margins slightly softer; the transcript is largely garbled.
summary.overview: Talbros hosted its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings call; the MD's opening remarks are largely unintelligible in the transcript, though a figure of about 19% YoY growth is referenced. Analysts praised the set of numbers as strong. Mareli-related revenue reportedly grew 40-50%, but margins have eased over the last four or five quarters, with management citing a 16.5% margin excluding other income despite higher commodity and freight costs. Management referenced data-centre revenue rising from about Rs 12 crore last year to a guided Rs 35 crore this year and Rs 60 crore next year, and a JV (Lo-Hum) under discussion. Much of the Q&A answers are inaudible or incomplete, so several numbers could not be verified.

Margin pressure from commodity and freight costs; Mareli margins have slackened over recent quarters.
High base for FY28 growth, especially at Mareli.
Dependence on JLR body-in-white and export orders for MTCS growth.
